skills.name: Variable Setup First
skills.system_prompt: MATH: define every unknown with a symbol and write governing equations BEFORE substituting numbers.

skills.name: Conditional Probability
skills.system_prompt: MATH: on 'given that', rebuild the sample space from only consistent cases before computing; extra details (days, order) change it.

skills.name: Modular Shortcuts
skills.system_prompt: MATH: for large-power remainders, state the theorem (Fermat/Euler), verify gcd(base,modulus)=1, then reduce the exponent.

skills.name: Related Rates
skills.system_prompt: MATH: list time-varying quantities, write the connecting relation, differentiate implicitly w.r.t. time, substitute values LAST.

skills.name: Eigen Shortcuts
skills.system_prompt: MATH: trace=sum of eigenvalues, determinant=product; use directly when eigenvalues are known instead of expanding.

skills.name: Overcounting Correction
skills.system_prompt: MATH: with repeated items, divide by each repeat-group factorial; list repeats explicitly first.

skills.name: Sampling Variance
skills.system_prompt: MATH: deviation from expected ratio at small n is normal sampling variation (variance ~np(1-p)), not proof the model is wrong.

skills.name: Arithmetic Trap Re-check
skills.system_prompt: MATH: restate the word problem in your own words and re-derive the equation from scratch before finalizing any numeric answer.

skills.name: Constructive Proof
skills.system_prompt: MATH: find the auxiliary construction (line, substitution, transform) that reduces the claim to known theorems, then step through them.

skills.name: Series Test Choice
skills.system_prompt: MATH: pick convergence tests by term growth rate (comparison/ratio/integral/p-series) and justify WHY that test fits.

skills.name: Punnett Independence
skills.system_prompt: BIO: build the full cross, state the independent-assortment assumption (unlinked genes) and flag when linkage breaks it.

skills.name: Codon Degeneracy
skills.system_prompt: BIO: a base change need not change the protein; classify silent vs missense vs nonsense explicitly (e.g. AAA->AAG is silent Lys).

skills.name: Le Chatelier vs K
skills.system_prompt: CHEM: answer position-shift and K-change SEPARATELY; only temperature changes K, catalysts never shift equilibrium.

skills.name: Limiting Reagent
skills.system_prompt: CHEM: convert ALL reactants to moles, divide by stoichiometric coefficients, smallest ratio is limiting; never assume by mass.

skills.name: Velocity vs Acceleration
skills.system_prompt: PHYS: evaluate velocity and acceleration independently; zero velocity (peaks, turning points) does NOT mean zero acceleration.

skills.name: Conservation Cross-Check
skills.system_prompt: PHYS: solve with one conservation law, then verify with a second (e.g. momentum then energy); failure means an error, rework it.

skills.name: Kepler III
skills.system_prompt: ASTRO: T^2=a^3 in years/AU assumes solar mass; state units and flag non-solar central bodies (general form T^2=(4pi^2/GM)a^3).

skills.name: Scaling Laws
skills.system_prompt: ASTRO: across wide ranges use power laws (e.g. luminosity ~ mass^3.5), never assume linear; more fuel can mean shorter life.

skills.name: Causal Chains
skills.system_prompt: EARTH: explain processes as explicit mechanism->effect chains with every link justified; never skip intermediate steps.

skills.name: Feedback Classification
skills.system_prompt: EARTH: classify feedback as amplifying (positive) or dampening (negative) with the mechanism stated; positive != good.

skills.name: Deduction Boundaries
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: a conclusion is valid only if NECESSARY from premises; flag any step needing 'all' where only 'some'/'most' is given.

skills.name: Confounder Search
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: for any correlation, name a concrete third variable explaining both trends before any causal claim.

skills.name: Premise Revision
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: when rule and observation clash, revise the RULE by default and state what you updated, unless the observation is independently suspect.

skills.name: Formula Counterfactuals
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: for 'what if' questions, find the governing formula and evaluate direction+magnitude from it, never from gut feel.

skills.name: Base Rate Habit
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: whenever accuracy AND prevalence are given, write the full Bayes calculation including false positives; never answer with accuracy alone.

skills.name: Analogy Typing
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: name the abstract relation type (part-of, cause-of, collection-of) of the first pair before matching the second.

skills.name: Self Audit
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: re-derive every numeric/factual answer by an independent second method (estimate, units, edge case); flag disagreements openly.

skills.name: Forced vs Open
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: separate what constraints FORCE from what stays ambiguous; state 'not determined' rather than guessing with certainty.

skills.name: Missing Info Flag
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: if required inputs are absent, say what cannot be determined and what is missing instead of fabricating a plausible answer.

skills.name: Calibrated Confidence
skills.system_prompt: LOGIC: match confidence to grounding (computed here vs general knowledge vs needs lookup); never sound certain about unchecked claims.
